sample_mapping_evidence: Primary publication PMID42593479 specifies PBMC scRNA-seq from 43 prostate cancer participants and 16 healthy controls. The other 106 records are receptor modalities, not extra specimens. Per-participant healthy/control mapping remains unresolved: all 59 GEO source_name fields say prostate cancer patient; preserve source claims and leave disease not_harmonized until clinical metadata are reconciled.

title: SCAF2311_1-28019
extract_protocol_ch1: Whole blood was collected and Lymphocyte separation medium was added and then the samples were centrifuged at 1400 rpm for 30 min. The lymphocyte layer was transferred to a new tube, 1X phosphate-buffered saline (PBS) was added and then centrifuged.The supernatant was discarded and the remaining sample was resuspended in PBS and centrifuged at 800 rpm for 8 mins. The supernatant was again discarded and the sample was then resuspend in freezing media: RPMI + 20% human AB serum.The cells in the samples were counted and frozen in 900 µl of freezing media and 100 µl of DMSO per cryovial.Vials were stored in liquid nitrogen.

Library construction was performed at the Single Cell Analysis Facility, a core service with the Center for Cancer Research at the NCI, Bethesda, MD. scRNA-seq libraries were prepared with the Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 5’Reagent Kits V2 (10X Genomics; PN-1000263, PN-1000265, PN-1000190, PN-1000252, PN-1000253) following the manufacturer’s instruction. Briefly, cells were partitioned into nanoliter-scale Gel-beads-in-Emulsion (GEMs), generated by combining barcoded Gel Beads, a Master Mix containing  cells, and Partitioning Oil onto Chromium Next GEM Chip K. After successful completion of uniform emulsion consistency, the reverse transcription was run overnight to amplify full length cDNA. Simplified cDNA was then used to amplify full-length V(D)J segments, followed V(D)J library construction and 5' gene expression library construction. All the steps including TCR and BCR enrichment libraries and QC steps were performed as described in the 10X Genomics 5’ v2 Single Cell User Guide.
data_processing: The demultiplexing, the primary analysis output, gene counting and TCR and BCR counting were performed by Cell Ranger Software. Base calling was performed using RTA 3.9.2, demultiplexing was performed using cellranger v6.1.1 (Bcl2fastq 2.20.0), and alignment was performed using cellranger v6.1.1 (STAR 2.7.2a). Sequenced reads were aligned to the 10x Genomics provided human reference sequence (refdata-gex-GRCh38-2020-A).

PBMCs from the 59 patients yielded ≥ 3 cells per isolation with a total of 322897 cells that were merged using the Merge() function. After merging, cells with less than 200 nFeature RNA or more than 10% mitochondrial reads were excluded using Seurat v4.3.0
The V(D)J sequencing data were analyzed with the djvdj R package for single-cell V(D)J data.
Assembly: GRCh38

Supplementary files format and content: H5 file containing per-molecule information for all molecules that contain a valid barcode, a valid UMI, and were assigned with high confidence to a gene or Feature Barcode.
Supplementary files format and content: Filtered_contig_annotations.csv contains annotations of each high-confidence cell barcode.

The supernatant was again discarded and the sample was then resuspend in freezing media: RPMI + 20% human AB serum.The cells in the samples were counted and frozen in 900 µl of freezing media and 100 µl of DMSO per cryovial.Vials were stored in liquid nitrogen.

Library construction was performed at the Single Cell Analysis Facility, a core service with the Center for Cancer Research at the NCI, Bethesda, MD. scRNA-seq libraries were prepared with the Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 5’Reagent Kits V2 (10X Genomics; PN-1000263, PN-1000265, PN-1000190, PN-1000252, PN-1000253) following the manufacturer’s instruction. Briefly, cells were partitioned into nanoliter-scale Gel-beads-in-Emulsion (GEMs), generated by combining barcoded Gel Beads, a Master Mix containing  cells, and Partitioning Oil onto Chromium Next GEM Chip K. After successful completion of uniform emulsion consistency, the reverse transcription was run overnight to amplify full length cDNA. Simplified cDNA was then used to amplify full-length V(D)J segments, followed V(D)J library construction and 5' gene expression library construction. All the steps including TCR and BCR enrichment libraries and QC steps were performed as described in the 10X Genomics 5’ v2 Single Cell User Guide.
data_processing: The demultiplexing, the primary analysis output, gene counting and TCR and BCR counting were performed by Cell Ranger Software. Base calling was performed using RTA 3.9.2, demultiplexing was performed using cellranger v6.1.1 (Bcl2fastq 2.20.0), and alignment was performed using cellranger v6.1.1 (STAR 2.7.2a). Sequenced reads were aligned to the 10x Genomics provided human reference sequence (refdata-gex-GRCh38-2020-A).

PBMCs from the 59 patients yielded ≥ 3 cells per isolation with a total of 322897 cells that were merged using the Merge() function. After merging, cells with less than 200 nFeature RNA or more than 10% mitochondrial reads were excluded using Seurat v4.3.0
The V(D)J sequencing data were analyzed with the djvdj R package for single-cell V(D)J data.
Assembly: GRCh38

Supplementary files format and content: Filtered_contig_annotations.csv contains annotations of each high-confidence cell barcode.

The lymphocyte layer was transferred to a new tube, 1X phosphate-buffered saline (PBS) was added and then centrifuged.The supernatant was discarded and the remaining sample was resuspended in PBS and centrifuged at 800 rpm for 8 mins. The supernatant was again discarded and the sample was then resuspend in freezing media: RPMI + 20% human AB serum.The cells in the samples were counted and frozen in 900 µl of freezing media and 100 µl of DMSO per cryovial.Vials were stored in liquid nitrogen.

Library construction was performed at the Single Cell Analysis Facility, a core service with the Center for Cancer Research at the NCI, Bethesda, MD. scRNA-seq libraries were prepared with the Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 5’Reagent Kits V2 (10X Genomics; PN-1000263, PN-1000265, PN-1000190, PN-1000252, PN-1000253) following the manufacturer’s instruction. Briefly, cells were partitioned into nanoliter-scale Gel-beads-in-Emulsion (GEMs), generated by combining barcoded Gel Beads, a Master Mix containing  cells, and Partitioning Oil onto Chromium Next GEM Chip K. After successful completion of uniform emulsion consistency, the reverse transcription was run overnight to amplify full length cDNA. Simplified cDNA was then used to amplify full-length V(D)J segments, followed V(D)J library construction and 5' gene expression library construction. All the steps including TCR and BCR enrichment libraries and QC steps were performed as described in the 10X Genomics 5’ v2 Single Cell User Guide.
data_processing: The demultiplexing, the primary analysis output, gene counting and TCR and BCR counting were performed by Cell Ranger Software. Base calling was performed using RTA 3.9.2, demultiplexing was performed using cellranger v6.1.1 (Bcl2fastq 2.20.0), and alignment was performed using cellranger v6.1.1 (STAR 2.7.2a). Sequenced reads were aligned to the 10x Genomics provided human reference sequence (refdata-gex-GRCh38-2020-A).

PBMCs from the 59 patients yielded ≥ 3 cells per isolation with a total of 322897 cells that were merged using the Merge() function. After merging, cells with less than 200 nFeature RNA or more than 10% mitochondrial reads were excluded using Seurat v4.3.0
The V(D)J sequencing data were analyzed with the djvdj R package for single-cell V(D)J data.
Assembly: GRCh38

Supplementary files format and content: H5 file containing per-molecule information for all molecules that contain a valid barcode, a valid UMI, and were assigned with high confidence to a gene or Feature Barcode.
Supplementary files format and content: Filtered_contig_annotations.csv contains annotations of each high-confidence cell barcode.

The supernatant was again discarded and the sample was then resuspend in freezing media: RPMI + 20% human AB serum.The cells in the samples were counted and frozen in 900 µl of freezing media and 100 µl of DMSO per cryovial.Vials were stored in liquid nitrogen.

Library construction was performed at the Single Cell Analysis Facility, a core service with the Center for Cancer Research at the NCI, Bethesda, MD. scRNA-seq libraries were prepared with the Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 5’Reagent Kits V2 (10X Genomics; PN-1000263, PN-1000265, PN-1000190, PN-1000252, PN-1000253) following the manufacturer’s instruction. Briefly, cells were partitioned into nanoliter-scale Gel-beads-in-Emulsion (GEMs), generated by combining barcoded Gel Beads, a Master Mix containing  cells, and Partitioning Oil onto Chromium Next GEM Chip K. After successful completion of uniform emulsion consistency, the reverse transcription was run overnight to amplify full length cDNA. Simplified cDNA was then used to amplify full-length V(D)J segments, followed V(D)J library construction and 5' gene expression library construction. All the steps including TCR and BCR enrichment libraries and QC steps were performed as described in the 10X Genomics 5’ v2 Single Cell User Guide.

The supernatant was again discarded and the sample was then resuspend in freezing media: RPMI + 20% human AB serum.The cells in the samples were counted and frozen in 900 µl of freezing media and 100 µl of DMSO per cryovial.Vials were stored in liquid nitrogen.

Library construction was performed at the Single Cell Analysis Facility, a core service with the Center for Cancer Research at the NCI, Bethesda, MD. scRNA-seq libraries were prepared with the Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 5’Reagent Kits V2 (10X Genomics; PN-1000263, PN-1000265, PN-1000190, PN-1000252, PN-1000253) following the manufacturer’s instruction. Briefly, cells were partitioned into nanoliter-scale Gel-beads-in-Emulsion (GEMs), generated by combining barcoded Gel Beads, a Master Mix containing  cells, and Partitioning Oil onto Chromium Next GEM Chip K. After successful completion of uniform emulsion consistency, the reverse transcription was run overnight to amplify full length cDNA. Simplified cDNA was then used to amplify full-length V(D)J segments, followed V(D)J library construction and 5' gene expression library construction. All the steps including TCR and BCR enrichment libraries and QC steps were performed as described in the 10X Genomics 5’ v2 Single Cell User Guide.
data_processing: The demultiplexing, the primary analysis output, gene counting and TCR and BCR counting were performed by Cell Ranger Software. Base calling was performed using RTA 3.9.2, demultiplexing was performed using cellranger v6.1.1 (Bcl2fastq 2.20.0), and alignment was performed using cellranger v6.1.1 (STAR 2.7.2a). Sequenced reads were aligned to the 10x Genomics provided human reference sequence (refdata-gex-GRCh38-2020-A).

PBMCs from the 59 patients yielded ≥ 3 cells per isolation with a total of 322897 cells that were merged using the Merge() function. After merging, cells with less than 200 nFeature RNA or more than 10% mitochondrial reads were excluded using Seurat v4.3.0
The V(D)J sequencing data were analyzed with the djvdj R package for single-cell V(D)J data.
Assembly: GRCh38
